## 简体中文

### 修复

- 悬停任务栏应用时立即显示窗口预览，同时保留短暂的关闭延迟。
- 匹配 Windows 窗口预览缩略图比例，并完善预览面板样式。

## English

### Fixed

- Showed window previews immediately when hovering over a taskbar app while retaining a short dismissal delay.
- Matched Windows preview thumbnail proportions and refined preview panel styling.
